name: How long do minor framing adjustments typically take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long do minor framing adjustments typically take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most minor framing modifications take between one and two days of active carpentry work, depending on wall accessibility and whether hidden utilities exist inside the cavity. A simple project like shifting an interior doorway or framing a shower niche can take just a few hours once the drywall is opened up. However, the total project timeline expands if plumbing pipes or electrical wiring require rerouting before framing can proceed. Because HH Remodeling manages both the carpentry and coordinated sub-trades on site, trades are sequenced back-to-back to minimize downtime between framing, drywall patching, and painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Active framing adjustments typically take one to two days. Additional time may be needed if plumbing lines or electrical wiring within the wall cavity must be rerouted.
